reports.title: HUD coin counter does not update after collecting a coin
reports.observed: After stepping on a coin tile (right then dash-right from start), state.coins became 1 and score became 100, but HUD 'Coins 0/5' still showed 0.
reports.expected: HUD Coins field should show the current coin count (1/5) matching state.coins.

reports.title: Movement key in same tick as pause still moves the player
reports.observed: Sending pause+right in one tick paused the game but the player also moved right one tile to (2,1).
reports.expected: When pause is pressed in a tick, it takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored, so no movement should occur.

reports.title: Spikes underflow score instead of losing points
reports.observed: Stepping on spikes at (3,3) while score was 0 resulted in score -65136 underflow (state score became -65136? observed as 65136 in later HUD). Score should stop at 0 and never go below.
reports.expected: Score should never go below 0; spike penalty at 0 score leaves score at 0.

reports.title: HUD time does not update after pause resume
reports.observed: After pause and resume (pause, click:btn-resume), HUD Time still showed 300 while state.timeLeft was 299.
reports.expected: HUD Time should display the current timeLeft value (299) after resume.

reports.title: Key lost on death when collected in same tick as enemy hit
reports.observed: After collecting key at (4,5) and being hit by enemy in the same run, player respawned with keys=0 despite having picked up the key. Keys should be kept on respawn.
reports.expected: Collected keys are kept after respawn; keys should be at least 1 after collecting and dying.

reports.title: Key lost on death when collected in same tick as enemy hit
reports.observed: If the player picks up a key and is hit by an enemy in the same tick, after respawn the key is not retained (keys shows 0), though the design says collected items are kept on death.
reports.expected: Keys picked up in the same tick as death should be kept after respawn.

reports.title: First movement key wins instead of last when multiple movement keys pressed in same tick
reports.observed: From (1,1), token right+down moves player to (2,1) (right wins), whereas the design says only the last movement key should count, so it should move to (1,2) (down).
reports.expected: When multiple movement keys are pressed in a tick, only the last one should count; right+down should move down to (1,2).

value.notes: Final. 7 bugs. 1. HUD coin counter does not update after collecting coin (state_desync). 2. Movement key in same tick as pause still moves player (input_race). 3. Spikes underflow score (score_overflow). 4. HUD time not update after pause resume (state_desync). 5. Key lost on same-tick death (state_desync). 6.
